title: Borrow checked UTF-8 slices
summary: Use checked byte ranges, observe the difference between bytes and characters, and inspect non-owning array slices.

owned.clue: Owned UTF-8 text type used to construct text

view.clue: Borrowed UTF-8 slice type for the valid prefix

checked.clue: Method returning an optional slice rather than panicking for an invalid byte range

valid.clue: Method extracting the slice from the known-valid Some result in this assertion program

invalid.clue: Method testing that a range cutting through a UTF-8 character was rejected

byteLen.clue: String method reporting the number of bytes, not Unicode scalar values

characters.clue: Method iterating Unicode scalar values in text

arraySlice.clue: Shared slice reference type for a contiguous view of signed 32-bit integers

equal.clue: Macro checking the two middle array elements
